new_defect.title: POST /booking with required fields missing answers 500
new_defect.description:
Environment: restful-booker practice API (api-test). Role: none (no authentication).
Steps: POST /booking with the JSON body {"lastname": "OnlyLastname"} (no firstname, totalprice, depositpaid, bookingdates).
Expected: 4xx (client error). The documentation is silent about errors; RFC 9110 §15.5–15.6: invalid input = 4xx.
Observed: 500 Internal Server Error, body "Internal Server Error" (555 ms, 24.09.2026 11:31).
Redacted evidence: runs/evidence/TC-API-009.json.
